meta.title: 50 Seeds
meta.description: AI 作图热门视觉种子库，每类 50 条。
meta.ranking: priority 在每个分类内从 1 到 50，1 为综合热度最高。排名综合当前关注度、主流榜单、长期文化影响力与 AI 作图适用性，并非实时官方统计。
meta.englishRanking: Priority runs from 1 to 50 within each category, with 1 as the strongest composite popularity rank. It blends current attention, major charts, long-term cultural impact, and usefulness for AI image prompts; it is not an official real-time metric.
